meta.description: Daily curated Claude AI skills news for small and medium businesses

entries.title: Anthropic Launches 'Claude for Small Business' — QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign All in One Toggle
entries.summary: Anthropic dropped a direct SMB bomb: Claude for Small Business is a toggle install inside Claude Cowork that connects QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365. Ships with 15 ready-to-run agentic workflows — planning payroll, closing the month, running sales campaigns, chasing invoices, triaging leads, analyzing margins — all with human approval before anything sends or pays. Also includes a free AI Fluency course (14 lectures, 1+ hour video) and a national SMB Tour starting May 14 in Chicago. For SMB owners: this is the closest thing to a 'Claude in a box' for your entire business operations. Toggle it on at claude.com/solutions/small-business.

entries.title: Anthropic Releases 20+ MCP Connectors and 12 Plugins for Legal Industry — Docusign, Ironclad, Thomson Reuters, Harvey, and More
entries.summary: Anthropic launched the largest legal AI package to date: 20+ MCP connectors linking Claude to Docusign, Ironclad, Box, Datasite, iManage, NetDocuments, Relativity, Everlaw, Thomson Reuters (CoCounsel), Harvey, Solve Intelligence, and more. Plus 12 practice-area plugins (Commercial, Corporate, Employment, Privacy, Litigation, IP, Real Estate, Tax, etc.) that learn your playbook via setup interview. Legal professionals are already the most engaged Claude Cowork users. For law firm SMBs and solo practitioners: connect your entire practice stack to Claude in minutes — contract review, diligence, research, and filings all in one conversation. Free public service connectors include Courtroom5, Free Law Project, and Descrybe.

entries.title: iOS 27 to Let SMB Owners Choose Claude for Siri, Writing Tools, and Apple Intelligence — 'Extensions' System Coming This Fall
entries.summary: Bloomberg reports Apple's iOS 27 (coming this fall) will let users choose from multiple third-party AI models — including Claude — to power Siri, Writing Tools, Image Playground, and more via a new 'Extensions' system. Users can even set different Siri voices for different AI models. For SMB owners running on Apple devices: your Claude workflows will soon integrate natively across your iPhone, iPad, and Mac operating system — no app-switching needed. WWDC 2026 kicks off June 8 where this will be officially announced.

entries.title: Claude Code Postmortem Reveals Three Quality Bugs — Anthropic Resets Usage Limits for All Subscribers
entries.summary: Anthropic published a detailed postmortem tracing recent Claude Code quality complaints to three separate bugs: (1) default reasoning effort lowered from high to medium (reverted April 7), (2) a caching bug that dropped thinking history on every turn after idle sessions (fixed April 10), and (3) a verbosity prompt change that hurt coding quality (reverted April 20). All fixed as of v2.1.116. Usage limits reset globally for all subscribers on April 23. For SMB dev teams: if you noticed Claude Code feeling 'dumber' in March/April, this explains why — and the fixes are live now. Update to the latest version and you should see the improvement.

entries.title: Xcode 26.5 Adds Message Queuing and Clarifying Questions for AI Coding Agents — Better Claude Code Integration
entries.summary: Apple's Xcode 26.5 release adds two features that make agentic coding (via Claude Code, Claude Agent, Codex, etc.) significantly more useful: message queuing so developers can line up instructions without waiting for the agent to finish, and clarifying questions so agents can ask for confirmation before proceeding. For SMBs building iOS/macOS apps: these features make Claude Code integration in Xcode much smoother for day-to-day development — less waiting, fewer wrong turns. Update via the Mac App Store.

entries.title: Airbnb Says AI Now Writes 60% of Its Code — Signal for SMBs That AI-Powered Development Is the New Normal
entries.summary: Airbnb revealed during its Q1 2026 earnings call that 60% of new code is now AI-generated — joining Google (75% AI-generated code), Microsoft, and Spotify in this accelerating trend. CEO Brian Chesky noted AI gives 'huge leverage' where one engineer can now do what a team of 20 previously could. Airbnb's customer support AI bot now handles 40% of issues without human escalation (up from 33%). For SMB owners and freelancers: this isn't just for big tech — Claude Code and similar tools put this same leverage in your hands today. If you're not using AI-assisted development yet, you're falling behind competitors who are.
